description: This file implements a snapshot management system for etcd, including saving, loading, and cleanup of snapshot files, with CRC validation and error handling.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: A struct managing snapshot files including saving, loading, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Snapshotter instance with specified logger and directory.

methods.name: SaveSnap
methods.description: Saves a raftpb.Snapshot to disk if it is not empty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Internal method to serialize and write a snapshot to disk.

methods.name: LoadNewestAvailable
methods.description: Loads the newest snapshot matching the provided wal snapshots.

methods.name: loadMatching
methods.description: Internal method to load the newest snapshot matching a condition.

methods.name: loadSnap
methods.description: Reads and unmarshals a snapshot file by name.

methods.name: snapNames
methods.description: Returns snapshot filenames ordered from newest to oldest.

methods.name: checkSuffix
methods.description: Filters filenames to include only snapshot files.

methods.name: cleanupSnapdir
methods.description: Removes orphaned or temporary files from the snapshot directory.

methods.name: ReleaseSnapDBs
methods.description: Deletes snapshot database files with index less than the current snapshot.
